mapper.insert: insert into solution_comment(solution_id, user_id, parent_id, root_id, reply_to_user, content, like_count, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{solutionId}, #{userId}, #{parentId}, #{rootId}, #{replyToUser}, #{content}, 0, 0, now(), now())
mapper.select: select id, solution_id, user_id, parent_id, root_id, reply_to_user, content, like_count, status, create_time, update_time from solution_comment where id = #{id} and status = 0

select c.id, c.solution_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.root_id, c.reply_to_user, c.content, c.like_count, c.status, c.create_time, c.update_time from solution_comment c where c.solution_id = #{solutionId} and c.root_id is null and ( c.status = 0 or exists (select 1 from solution_comment r where r.root_id = c.id and r.status = 0) ) order by c.id desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}

select count(*) from solution_comment c where c.solution_id = #{solutionId} and c.root_id is null and ( c.status = 0 or exists (select 1 from solution_comment r where r.root_id = c.id and r.status = 0) )
mapper.update: update solution_comment set status = 1 where id = #{id} and status = 0
update solution_comment set status = 1 where solution_id = #{solutionId} and status = 0
update solution_comment set like_count = like_count + 1 where id = #{id}
update solution_comment set like_count = GREATEST(like_count - 1, 0) where id = #{id}
update solution_comment set like_count = #{likeCount} where id = #{id}
